description: Connects a subdomain of the customer's domain to Clover email sending and receiving through Resend: DKIM, the return-path records (MX with SPF merged via SPFM, and/or one or two Resend MTA CNAMEs) and the inbound MX. The service applies only the groups that match the records Resend issued for the domain. Applies only with a host (subdomain); the apex and its mail records are never touched.
variableDescription: %dkimkey%: DKIM public key issued by Resend for the domain (base64, without the p= prefix); %region%: Resend sending region (e.g. eu-west-1); %returnpath%: return-path label issued by Resend (e.g. send); %mtahost%: label of the Resend MTA CNAME (e.g. rsend); %mtatarget%: first label of the Resend MTA target under forge.rmta.net (e.g. send); %fallbackhost%: label of the second Resend MTA CNAME, when Resend issues two (e.g. send); %fallbacktarget%: first label of that second target under forge.rmta.net (e.g. rsend-euw1)
